A '''guard captain''' helped [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] and [[Kelleran Beq]] escape [[Coruscant]] during [[Operation: Knightfall]]. The guard was killed by [[clone trooper]]s.<ref name="Chapter 20" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The guard first appeared in "[[Chapter 20: The Foundling]]," the fourth episode of [[The Mandalorian Season Three|season three]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''. The captain is credited as "Senate Guard Captain," and was portrayed by actor [[Juan Javier Cardenas]].<ref name="Chapter 20" />
